passages.text: My son, if you accept my words and hide my commandments within you, if you incline your ear to wisdom and direct your heart to understanding, if you truly call out to insight and lift your voice to understanding, if you seek it like silver and search it out like hidden treasure, then you will discern the fear of the LORD and discover the knowledge of God.
passages.sermon:
A father speaks to his son.
He gives his son advice.
He says, “My son, listen to my words.
Keep my commandments inside you.
Turn your ear to wisdom.
Set your heart on understanding.
Call out for insight.
Raise your voice for understanding.
Look for wisdom as you would look for silver.
Search for understanding as you would search for hidden treasure.
If you do these things, you will understand what it means to fear the LORD.
You will find the knowledge of God.”
passages.original: בְּ֭נִי אִם־ תִּקַּ֣ח אֲמָרָ֑י וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י תִּצְפֹּ֥ן אִתָּֽךְ׃ לְהַקְשִׁ֣יב לַֽחָכְמָ֣ה אָזְנֶ֑ךָ תַּטֶּ֥ה לִ֝בְּךָ֗ לַתְּבוּנָֽה׃ כִּ֤י אִ֣ם לַבִּינָ֣ה תִקְרָ֑א לַ֝תְּבוּנָ֗ה תִּתֵּ֥ן קוֹלֶֽךָ׃ אִם־ תְּבַקְשֶׁ֥נָּה כַכָּ֑סֶף וְֽכַמַּטְמוֹנִ֥ים תַּחְפְּשֶֽׂנָּה׃ אָ֗ז תָּ֭בִין יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְדַ֖עַת אֱלֹהִ֣ים תִּמְצָֽא׃

passages.text: For the LORD gives wisdom; from His mouth come knowledge and understanding.
passages.sermon:
The LORD gives wisdom.
The LORD is God.
God gives wisdom to people.
Knowledge comes from God's mouth.
Understanding comes from God's mouth.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ יְ֭הוָה יִתֵּ֣ן חָכְמָ֑ה מִ֝פִּ֗יו דַּ֣עַת וּתְבוּנָֽה׃

passages.text: He stores up sound wisdom for the upright; He is a shield to those who walk with integrity, to guard the paths of justice and protect the way of His saints.
passages.sermon:
God gives wisdom to people who are upright.
God keeps sound wisdom safe for them.
God protects people who live with integrity.
God guards the paths of justice.
God watches over the way of His faithful people.
passages.original: וְצָפַן לַ֭יְשָׁרִים תּוּשִׁיָּ֑ה מָ֝גֵ֗ן לְהֹ֣לְכֵי תֹֽם׃ לִ֭נְצֹר אָרְח֣וֹת מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְדֶ֖רֶךְ חֲסִידוֹ יִשְׁמֹֽר׃

passages.text: Then you will discern righteousness and justice and equity—every good path.
passages.sermon:
God gives wisdom.
God gives knowledge and understanding.
God stores up wisdom for upright people.
God protects those who walk with integrity.
God guards the paths of justice.
God protects the way of His faithful people.
When you receive wisdom from God, you will understand righteousness.
You will understand justice.
You will understand fairness.
You will recognize every good path.
passages.original: אָ֗ז תָּ֭בִין צֶ֣דֶק וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ֝מֵישָׁרִ֗ים כָּל־ מַעְגַּל־ טֽוֹב׃

passages.text: For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will delight your soul.
passages.sermon: Wisdom will come into your heart.\r\nKnowledge will bring joy to your soul.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ תָב֣וֹא חָכְמָ֣ה בְלִבֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝דַ֗עַת לְֽנַפְשְׁךָ֥ יִנְעָֽם׃

passages.text: Discretion will watch over you, and understanding will guard you, to deliver you from the way of evil, from the man who speaks perversity, from those who leave the straight paths to walk in the ways of darkness, from those who enjoy doing evil and rejoice in the twistedness of evil, whose paths are crooked and whose ways are devious.
passages.sermon:
Discretion will watch over you.
Understanding will guard you.
Discretion and understanding will protect you from evil ways.
They will save you from the man who speaks perversity.
Some people leave the straight paths.
They choose to walk in the ways of darkness.
These people enjoy doing evil.
They rejoice in the twistedness of evil.
Their paths are crooked.
Their ways are devious.
passages.original: מְ֭זִמָּה תִּשְׁמֹ֥ר עָלֶ֗יךָ תְּבוּנָ֥ה תִנְצְרֶֽכָּה׃ לְ֭הַצִּ֣ילְךָ מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ רָ֑ע מֵ֝אִ֗ישׁ מְדַבֵּ֥ר תַּהְפֻּכֽוֹת׃ הַ֭עֹ֣זְבִים אָרְח֣וֹת יֹ֑שֶׁר לָ֝לֶ֗כֶת בְּדַרְכֵי־ חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃ הַ֭שְּׂמֵחִים לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת רָ֑ע יָ֝גִ֗ילוּ בְּֽתַהְפֻּכ֥וֹת רָֽע׃ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָרְחֹתֵיהֶ֣ם עִקְּשִׁ֑ים וּ֝נְלוֹזִ֗ים בְּמַעְגְּלוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: It will rescue you from the forbidden woman, from the stranger with seductive words who abandons the partner of her youth and forgets the covenant of her God.
passages.sermon:
Wisdom and understanding will protect you.
They will save you from a forbidden woman.
This woman is a stranger.
Her words are seductive.
She leaves the husband she loved in her youth.
She forgets the covenant she made with God.
passages.original: לְ֭הַצִּ֣ילְךָ מֵאִשָּׁ֣ה זָרָ֑ה מִ֝נָּכְרִיָּ֗ה אֲמָרֶ֥יהָ הֶחֱלִֽיקָה׃ הַ֭עֹזֶבֶת אַלּ֣וּף נְעוּרֶ֑יהָ וְאֶת־ בְּרִ֖ית אֱלֹהֶ֣יהָ שָׁכֵֽחָה׃

passages.text: For her house sinks down to death, and her tracks to the departed spirits.
passages.sermon:
The forbidden woman leads people to destruction.
Her house goes down to death.
Her path leads to the place of the dead.
Those who follow her go toward ruin.
Her ways end with those who have died.
passages.original: כִּ֤י שָׁ֣חָה אֶל־ מָ֣וֶת בֵּיתָ֑הּ וְאֶל־ רְ֝פָאִ֗ים מַעְגְּלֹתֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: None who go to her return or negotiate the paths of life.
passages.sermon: Anyone who goes to the forbidden woman does not return.\r\nThey do not find the paths of life.
passages.original: כָּל־ בָּ֭אֶיהָ לֹ֣א יְשׁוּב֑וּן וְלֹֽא־ יַ֝שִּׂ֗יגוּ אָרְח֥וֹת חַיִּֽים׃

passages.text: So you will follow in the ways of the good, and keep to the paths of the righteous.
passages.sermon: You will walk in the way of good people.\r\nYou will keep to the paths of the righteous.
passages.original: לְמַ֗עַן תֵּ֭לֵךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ טוֹבִ֑ים וְאָרְח֖וֹת צַדִּיקִ֣ים תִּשְׁמֹֽר׃

passages.text: For the upright will inhabit the land, and the blameless will remain in it; but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the unfaithful will be uprooted.
passages.sermon:
The upright live in the land.
The blameless stay in the land.
The wicked are cut off from the land.
The unfaithful are removed from the land.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ יְשָׁרִ֥ים יִשְׁכְּנוּ אָ֑רֶץ וּ֝תְמִימִ֗ים יִוָּ֥תְרוּ בָֽהּ׃ וּ֭רְשָׁעִים מֵאֶ֣רֶץ יִכָּרֵ֑תוּ וּ֝בוֹגְדִ֗ים יִסְּח֥וּ מִמֶּֽנָּה׃פ
